_comment: Auto-updated social stats. The weekly refresh writes new values here, then apply_stats.py pushes them into the HTML. Follower counts appear in the hero pills and Platforms & Analytics, so both share a data-stat key. The IG engagement rate is managed here too. Editorial numbers are hand-edited in content.html: the TikTok and Instagram best-post heroes, FYP %, all-time highlight cards, and Top posts captions.
